name: Dynamic Boolean Decision Gate
description: Evaluates accumulated security status or taint flags (e.g. is_blocked or taint_flags) and branches execution paths dynamically.

fields.name: block_on_any_taint
fields.label: Block on Any Security Taint Flag
fields.helperText: Route to out_block if any security taint flag (PII_DETECTED, TOXICITY_FLAG, etc.) is present.
